---
title: Simulator Setup
---

Start the simulator automatically with its interface, hand input, plane debug
views, and navigation mesh enabled. The initial mode is User.

Use the settings interface to change the environment or mode. This example
enables mode cycling with **Left Shift**. A navigation mesh grounds the camera
and disables free vertical movement; it does not constrain hand reach.

The [simulator controls guide](/sdk/simulator) owns the current movement and
hand-control instructions. Debug views help inspect evidence; hide them when
checking the application's user-facing feedback.

[Simulator environments](/sdk/simulator/environments) · [Example catalog](/examples)
